chapters.reason: The paper introduces self-speculative decoding, which uses early layers as a draft model to verify against the full model, fitting the definition of speculative decoding and model-based routing.
The paper focuses on early exit mechanisms as a practical inference solution to speed up real-world tasks like summarization and semantic parsing.
The early exit mechanism acts as a form of dynamic toggling between 'fast' (early exit) and 'slow' (full model) reasoning paths within the same architecture.
